Update._comment: Velopack GithubSource repo URL. Velopack hits the GitHub API to discover the latest published Release and its attached RELEASES + .nupkg assets — no need for the '/releases/latest/download' alias (which only resolves when an asset filename is appended). Override FeedUrl with an empty string to disable update checks (e.g. for internal forks). CheckIntervalHours controls how often the background loop re-checks after the startup check — set to 0 to disable the loop (startup check still runs).

TokenFreshness._comment: Periodic check that each ready tenant's cached access token still carries every scope the host and its plugins need. A token is issued for a resource's '.default' scope, so it keeps serving whatever was consented when it was minted for its full lifetime (~1 hour), and MSAL's cache is persisted to disk - so admin consent granted mid-session, or even before a restart, is invisible until the token expires. When the check finds a consented scope missing from the token it force-refreshes silently (never interactively). CheckIntervalMinutes set to 0 disables the loop. FirstCheckDelaySeconds staggers the first check away from the startup burst.

Plugins._comment: AllowUnsigned (default): prompt the user once at install time whenever a plugin isn't Authenticode-signed; load-time gate is open. RequireTrustedPublisher: org-managed mode — only load plugins signed by a thumbprint in TrustedPublisherThumbprints, no interactive override. UpdateCheckIntervalHours controls how often installed plugins are compared against nuget.org (0 disables the loop). AutoUpdate only seeds the Settings checkbox on first run — the user's own choice is persisted in plugin-updates.json and wins after that; even when enabled, an update carrying a High/Critical advisory or needing the unsigned-plugin prompt is refused and left for a manual install.

NuGet._comment: Plugins are discovered by querying nuget.org for packages tagged with DiscoveryTag. Authors publish their plugin to NuGet with that tag in <PackageTags>; the in-app browser surfaces every match. Override SearchUrl to point at a corporate NuGet mirror.
